overview.title: Progress, written with evidence
overview.intro: Review learning plans, lesson feedback, milestones, and progress reviews in one clear record.

plans.title: Learning plans
plans.body: Major goal changes wait for a parent acknowledgment before they become the active plan.

feedback.title: Lesson feedback
feedback.body: Tutors record structured, human-written notes after each lesson.

milestones.title: Milestones
milestones.body: Completion is tied to work, observation, rubric, or assessment evidence.

overview.privacy: Internal staff notes are not shown to parents or students.
